## ICloseSuggestionPullRequestsInput.owner property

Whose suggestion pull requests may be closed, by who opened them; the default is `'me'`<!-- -->. A conforming suggestion someone else opened is reported `other-owner` and left open.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly owner?: SuggestionOwnerScope | undefined;
```
